title: Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) Awards and the Outpatient Surgery Initial Deposit Base
content:
For the initial deposit on a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery booking under Good Faith & Price Estimates, an approved award of the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) that covers the scheduled service date changes the amount the initial deposit is figured on.

**Rule.** When the covering award's tier discount is above zero and below one hundred percent, the initial deposit is figured on the surgical package price reduced by that discount percentage. When the covering award carries no tier discount and has cap left, it is figured on the smaller of the surgical package price and the cap left. In every other case the award leaves the amount the initial deposit is figured on unchanged.

**Terms as the records show them.**
- *The patient's award*: the patient's approved financial assistance case, a patient holding at most one approved case at a time.
- *Covers the scheduled service date*: the date falls within the award period, which runs from the award start date through the award end date, both counted.
- *Tier discount*: the discount percentage of the award's Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) tier.
- *Cap left*: the award's hardship liability cap less the liabilities already booked on encounters under that case.
- *Surgical package price*: the Riverbend facility line plus the Riverbend professional line carrying the package's principal service code on the current version.

## Combinations

| Award covers the date | Tier discount | Cap left | Amount the initial deposit is figured on |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | above 0 and below 100 percent | any | the surgical package price reduced by the discount percentage |
| yes | 0 (no tier discount) | above zero | the smaller of the surgical package price and the cap left |
| yes | 0 (no tier discount) | none | not changed by the award |
| yes | 100 percent | any | not changed by the award |
| no | any | any | not changed by the award |
| no approved case | — | — | not changed by the award |

## Examples (hypothetical figures)

- Surgical package price 5000.00, covering award with a 60 percent tier discount: figured on 2000.00.
- Surgical package price 5000.00, covering award with no tier discount and 1200.00 of cap left: figured on 1200.00.
- The same award with 8000.00 of cap left: figured on 5000.00, the smaller of the two.
- An award whose period ends the day before the scheduled service date does not cover it.
